assertions.description: The rev3 left schematic uses U2 (TPS61220DCK) as a boost converter for battery voltage (+BATT) to VDD. The analyzer correctly identifies the feedback divider R3=1.2M (top) and R4=220k (bottom) on the FB pin, computes ratio=0.155, and estimates Vout=3.87V using a 0.6V reference (heuristic). The actual TPS61220 Vref is 0.5V which gives ~3.2V, but the output is labeled as 'heuristic' which is honest. The RT9013-33GB LDO (+5V to VDD at 3.3V) is also correctly identified. Both regulators sharing the VDD output rail is correctly captured.
assertions.migration_note: Path migrated from: signal_analysis.power_regulators[0].topology; TH-109 triage: {"path": "findings[0].topology", "op": "equals", "value": "switching", "detector_filter": "detect_power_regulators"} -> {"path": "findings", "op": "contains_match", "field": "ref", "pattern": "^U2$", "where": {"topology": "^switching$", "input_rail": "^\\+BATT$", "output_rail": "^VDD$"}, "detector_filter": "detect_power_regulators"} (TPS61220 U2 +BATT->VDD switching and RT9013 U1 +5V->VDD LDO, both on VDD. findings[0] is U1 today, so the indexed lock read the wrong regulator. Both pass (graduation candidate). File moved by 745481c)
